scope: Documented integration routes, not installed or qualified parser coverage.

harnesses.name: super.engineering
harnesses.engine: Includes Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi, Grok and other providers; surfaces/capabilities vary.
harnesses.evidence_route: Terminal is native CLI. Chat UI uses provider adapters; Claude noninteractive Chat UI follows a CLI path. Exact other Chat UI SDK/ACP/app-server wires remain unverified.

harnesses.name: Zeron
harnesses.engine: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi and ACP-native providers including Devin, Grok, Hermes and Antigravity.
harnesses.evidence_route: Claude stream-json subprocess; Codex app-server JSON-RPC stdio; Cursor pinned SDK shim; OpenCode HTTP/SSE; Pi JSONL RPC; ACP only ACP-native drivers.

harnesses.name: Paseo
harnesses.engine: Native adapters for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and others, plus a version-pinned ACP catalog.
harnesses.evidence_route: Claude Agent SDK uses installed claude CLI; Codex uses codex app-server; generic ACP providers use stdio initialize/capability negotiation.

harnesses.name: Diri
harnesses.engine: Existing Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, OpenCode and other agent CLIs; generic agents retain terminal surfaces.
harnesses.evidence_route: PTY/holder-based native CLI launches. Claude manifest declares hooks authority and minted --session-id; Codex manifest declares screen authority plus notify/MCP injection.

harnesses.name: T3 Code
harnesses.engine: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi, Muse and ACP Registry/flavored providers.
harnesses.evidence_route: Claude Agent SDK; Codex App Server; native adapters for other non-ACP protocols, including Pi RPC; shared ACP Registry/flavored adapters for ACP providers.

harnesses.name: Emdash
harnesses.engine: Installed coding-agent CLIs, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Amp; provider registry defines prompt, hooks, ACP and other capabilities.
harnesses.evidence_route: Two paths: legacy/TUI through PTY and TUI-agent runtimes; structured chat through ACP provider plugins and a Host ACP runtime. Explicit hooks/plugins drive TUI status.

harnesses.name: MonoCode
harnesses.engine: Locally installed/authenticated agent providers including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi and others. CLI discovery happens at startup.
harnesses.evidence_route: Desktop sessions plus an experimental remote host service. /operator enables a local app CLI in an active agent turn; sessions.list and sessions.start expose app-session references.

harnesses.name: Synara
harnesses.engine: Provider-native runtimes include Codex CLI/app-server, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi and others. Provider owns models, account, tools, permissions and limits.
harnesses.evidence_route: Durable projects/threads around provider sessions; internal thread-scoped Agent Gateway plus a separate user-paired External MCP stdio bridge to a loopback endpoint.

harnesses.name: bb
harnesses.engine: Provider processes on host daemons; configured providers include Claude Code, Codex, Pi and ACP agents. Custom ACP provider commands run on the thread's host.
harnesses.evidence_route: Central SQLite source of truth; HTTP and WebSocket server contract; separate host-daemon RPC/events contract; first-class CLI and SDK methods.

harnesses.name: Orca
harnesses.engine: CLI-agent host for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and other installed agent CLIs. The any-CLI statement describes execution compatibility, not telemetry completeness.
harnesses.evidence_route: Worktree/terminal coordination plus an Orca CLI for a running editor, JSON status, SSH execution, notifications and orchestration. Usage tracking is provider-specific.

harnesses.name: Traycer
harnesses.engine: Managed Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode CLIs and additional provider-specific integrations; Cursor chat uses an API key and needs no CLI; Traycer Inference is separate.
harnesses.evidence_route: traycer agent list --json; traycer agent transcript --agent-id; traycer agent inbox --after; traycer monitor CLI --json produces NDJSON progress/result envelopes; host status/log/doctor and data status discover the effective data folder. Default ~/.traycer/cli/config.json, ~/.traycer/host/, ~/.traycer/host/host.log, ~/.traycer/worktrees/; data folder may be relocated.

harnesses.name: Claude desktop
harnesses.engine: One app has distinct Chat, Cowork and Code surfaces. The Code tab uses the Claude Code engine, while Chat export and Cowork policy/telemetry are distinct.
harnesses.evidence_route: Code-tab OTEL service.name=claude-code-desktop; terminal service.name=claude-code; session.id and prompt.id correlation. Code settings, hooks and skills share documented Claude configuration; CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR may relocate it. Account Chat history export from Settings > Privacy on web/Desktop, delivered by email. CLI JSONL default ~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session-id>.jsonl is documented for CLI; schema is internal and may change.

harnesses.name: Capy
harnesses.engine: Capy's own agent plus a separate Claude Code mode on the Claude Agent SDK; Captain and subagents coordinate work. Public control/evidence API uses REST and SSE.
harnesses.evidence_route: GET /api/v1/threads and /threads/{threadId}/messages; subagent message endpoints; paged after/before cursors. Thread/subagent SSE replays after Last-Event-ID; transcript event cursors never expire and pagination is stable across compaction. GET /api/v1/usage returns token totals plus member/model breakdowns; capy dock --verbose prints dock logs.

harnesses.name: Cloudroom
harnesses.engine: Native harness processes: Codex app-server over stdio; Claude Code stream JSON without SDK bridge; Pi RPC; OpenCode ACP. Other adapters have their own native boundaries.
harnesses.evidence_route: GET /v1/sessions, per-session requests, events?after=N, and SSE stream with Last-Event-ID. CLOUDROOM_STATE_DIR local journal; setup example /var/lib/cloudroom/history. Self-host CLOUDROOM_LOCAL_HISTORY=1; managed history also goes to API-backed gzip object storage. CLOUDROOM_CODEX_HOME and account homes are explicit; native history remains adapter-owned. Private diagnostics.jsonl under state directory is bounded operational telemetry, distinct from full conversation history.

harnesses.name: Superset
harnesses.engine: Terminal CLI agent orchestration; the app does not proxy model calls. Chat uses the installed CLI over ACP and can resume the same session in terminal.
harnesses.evidence_route: superset agents read returns saved Claude Code/Codex transcripts; other agent transcript reads fail rather than silently fall back to terminal output. Lifecycle hooks/command wrappers under ~/.paradev/bin and superset-hooks are active only inside marked Paradev terminals. SUPERSET_HOME_DIR (default ~/.paradev) relocates config.json and the host tree; documented host state includes manifest.json and host.db. Usage reads local native session logs and official account usage endpoints; it does not aggregate remote hosts. Profiles use CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/CODEX_HOME.

harnesses.name: Codex app
harnesses.engine: Codex app-server structured thread, turn and item API; native CODEX_HOME state.
harnesses.evidence_route: app_server SQLite state can use sqlite_home/CODEX_SQLITE_HOME separately from CODEX_HOME.

harnesses.name: Conductor
harnesses.engine: Managed Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode executables; Cursor API is a separate route.
harnesses.evidence_route: Managed executables and Cursor API.

harnesses.name: OpenCode
harnesses.engine: OpenCode server owns configured provider/model execution; TUI and desktop are clients. SDK is a typed HTTP/OpenAPI client, not a separate model engine.
harnesses.evidence_route: Server HTTP/OpenAPI API, SDK session list/status/children methods, and event.subscribe SSE. Native SQLite metadata is another versioned evidence surface.

harnesses.name: Gemini CLI
harnesses.engine: Native CLI with configured model/auth and tool runtime; documented telemetry describes Gemini API activity and execution events.
harnesses.evidence_route: Opt-in OpenTelemetry logs/metrics/traces, local OTLP target or telemetry outfile; separate ACP mode provides structured client interactions.

harnesses.name: Pi
harnesses.engine: Pi is a configurable agent harness/model runtime, available as CLI or an in-process Node/Bun SDK. Provider/model selection belongs to that runtime.
harnesses.evidence_route: File-backed JSONL session tree; SDK session.subscribe; JSON event stream; language-independent RPC subprocess over JSONL stdin/stdout.

harnesses.name: Cline
harnesses.engine: @cline/core supplies Node sessions/storage/hub/automation/telemetry over @cline/agents and @cline/llms. The browser-compatible agent loop is a lower layer.
harnesses.evidence_route: SDK subscribe/event interfaces and optional OTLP logs/metrics. Event reference includes task lifecycle, model/provider, token, tool and hook events.

harnesses.name: Rex
harnesses.engine: External Claude Code, Codex, Pi/OpenCode and other terminal programs
harnesses.evidence_route: Native engine records plus explicit REX_SESSION/REX_BLOCK context and OSC7501 status; status is not a transcript

harnesses.name: Zed
harnesses.engine: Zed Agent, external ACP agents and Terminal Threads are distinct modes.
harnesses.evidence_route: External agents use ACP and session history import; Terminal Threads run CLI agents. Built-in Zed Agent requires separate evidence mapping.

harnesses.name: VS Code Copilot
harnesses.engine: VSCode/Copilot agent harnesses and agent-host sessions
harnesses.evidence_route: Native OTel and explicit Agent DebugLog OTLP JSON session export; session.id is window-scoped

harnesses.name: Warp
harnesses.engine: Warp local agents and managed cloud runs
harnesses.evidence_route: Documented local conversation history and cloud-run session UI. A stable external transcript export/API contract is unverified.
